messages:
anya: Kicking off region-by-region rollout for release v2.3.1 in the maintenance window 02:00-06:00 UTC. Plan: US -> EU -> APAC. Will use canaries and then progressive slices. Please confirm capacity and any pin/rollback constraints. deploy-bot will post canary updates.

deploy-bot: Starting CANARY in us-west-2 for v2.3.1 (slice=canary, qps=25). Instances requested: 4. Pinned variant: v2.3.1-canary. Logs: initiating health checks.

raj: Quick capacity snapshot — us-west-2 has 22 available GPU pods, baseline load ~40%, can sustain the canary and ramp to slice=10% safely. EU (eu-west-1) has only 6 spare pods, baseline burst margin low. APAC (ap-northeast-1) currently has 2 spare pods only. Recommend limiting APAC concurrency or manual approval before APAC cutover.

luis: Noted. For APAC we should set max_concurrency=50% and enable fallback routing to v2.3.0 in case of any capacity or latency regression.

deploy-bot: Canary health checks: 2/2 success endpoints, p50 latency 85ms, error rate 0.18% (5m). Proceeding to US slice rollout: slice=30% -> starting gradual ramp.

anya: Good. Rollout policy: if error_rate > 1.5% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency increases by >150ms over baseline for 3m -> automatic rollback to v2.3.0 and pin traffic to stable for that region. infra-oncall, please watch traces and token-cost anomalies.

infra-oncall: Ack. I'll set an alert: trace_latency_p95 > 200ms for 3m OR error_rate > 1.5% -> page oncall and trigger rollback checklist. I'll also enable extra sampling for tails in US while ramping.

deploy-bot: US slice ramp to 30% complete. Metrics: p50 90ms, p95 180ms, error_rate 0.25%. No rollback triggers.

sasha: Heads up — release notes updated with the model/quantization changes and a known issue: slight tokenization variance for some non-Latin inputs. Adding eval set for EU languages to monitor quality regressions.

deploy-bot: Starting EU canary (eu-west-1) with requested instances: 3. Allocation attempt: 3 -> SUCCESS but remaining spare pods low (3 left).

raj: EU allocation succeeded but headroom is tight. Suggest limiting EU ramp to slice=15% initially and keep autoscale cooldowns long to avoid flapping. Also enable KV-cache warmup window to reduce cold-start token costs.

anya: Agreed. EU ramp to 15% only. If any node allocation fails or p95 > 250ms, pause and escalate. APAC stays pinned to v2.3.0 until manual go.

deploy-bot: EU canary metrics: p50 120ms, p95 240ms, error_rate 0.5%. Within thresholds. EU ramping to 15%.

luis: For APAC, propose two options: (1) staggered micro-slices (5% increments over 2 hours) with concurrency cap 50% or (2) keep pinned and do manual maintenance window to add capacity. Given current infra, I'd vote for option 1 if product is ok with slower ramp.

anya: Product confirmed slower ramp okay. Use option 1 but require manual approval before any >10% slice. infra-oncall, prep rollback commands and a hard-pin script: `redwoodctl pin-region --region ap-northeast-1 --version v2.3.0`.

infra-oncall: Pin script ready and tested in staging. Rollback runbook updated. Sample rollback command: ```
# rollback to stable in region
redwoodctl rollback --region {{region}} --to-version v2.3.0 --force
redwoodctl pin-region --region {{region}} --version v2.3.0
```

deploy-bot: Attempting APAC provisioning for micro-slice 5% -> ALLOCATION FAILED: insufficient free pods (requested=2, available=1). Suggest reduce requested instances or postpone.

anya: Ok hold on APAC. Do not attempt further APAC ramps. Keep APAC pinned to v2.3.0. Notify APAC on-call for manual capacity expansion if they want faster cutover.

sasha: I'll note in the release notes: APAC will remain on v2.3.0 until additional capacity is available; update support doc and set customer-facing flag if needed.

raj: I'll file a small infra task to provision +2 pods in ap-northeast-1 for tomorrow's maintenance window (non-blocking).

deploy-bot: US and EU slices at target (US 30%, EU 15%). No rollback triggers. APAC remains pinned. Rollout summary: US -> success, EU -> partial success, APAC -> deferred.

anya: Thanks all. Action items: (1) Monitor US/EU for 1 hour, (2) do not cut APAC without manual approval, (3) infra to provision extra APAC capacity tomorrow, (4) update release notes and support doc. I'll close the window if no regressions. :thumbsup:

sasha: Copy, updating docs now. :white_check_mark:

luis: LGTM, standing by for any rollback.

infra-oncall: Alerts configured, rollback playbook on standby.

deploy-bot: Closing thread status: rolling -> monitoring. Automated watches active.
